summary: Two text areas with a character counter: a post with a soft 280-character limit and a report whose count appears only from 400 characters.
use: Composers and long-form fields where a length limit matters only near the end.
spec: Post has `counter={{ max: 280 }}` and no `maxlength`: typing may go past 280 and the count turns to the error tone
Report details has `maxlength={500}` and `counter={{ from: 400 }}`: no count below 400 characters
Both have `rows={3}` and a description beside the count
